nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.stage3_centerline¶

qvtpy stage 3: centerlines (eICAB in 4D-flow space + venous branches from CD).

Inputs

  • Stage-2 FLIRT transform, eICAB CW/WB mask, ComplexDifference_3D.

Outputs

  • eicab_in_4dflow.nii.gz, centerlines_mask.nii.gz, centerline_meta.json, cd_vessel_binary_qc.nii.gz under stage3_centerline/.

Functions¶

run_subject(→ pathlib.Path)

Warp eICAB, extract arterial/venous centerlines; return stage-3 output directory.

build_subject_sge_command(→ str)

Return the host shell command for one stage3 array/SGE task.

submit_subject_sge(→ str)

Emit or submit one stage-3 SGE job. Returns qsub job id.

main(→ None)

CLI entry point (qvtpy-stage3-centerline): run stage 3 centerline extraction
